guide.kumpel.core: Use the Kumpel Core on a block to awaken your own Kumpel: a small mining golem that follows you, collects dropped items, senses ores and levels up. Right-click it to let it sit or follow, sneak + right-click to open its backpack, feed it ores and gems for experience and repair it with copper ingots.

guide.kumpel.steiger_whistle: The Foreman's Whistle calls all your Kumpels within earshot, even the ones sitting down. Used while sneaking, it sends them all on a break. Used while sneaking on a chest (or any other container, modded ones too), it marks it as their storage: your Kumpels then bring their loot there instead of to you. Use it again to undo that. Used while sneaking on the side of any other block, the nearest Kumpel with a pickaxe digs a 1×2 tunnel into that wall. It stops in front of water, lava and drops, and puts what it digs into its backpack.
guide.kumpel.hauer: Give your Kumpel a pickaxe (right-click) and it mines exposed ores near you by itself. The pickaxe's tier and enchantments count, and it wears down. You get it back by opening the Kumpel's backpack.

guide.kumpel.canary_cage: Give the canary cage to your Kumpel (right-click). The bird on its shoulder warns you about monsters nearby, makes them glow, and speaks up when you run out of air underwater. With it, your Kumpel also senses creepers from further away. Pack the Kumpel up to get the cage back.

guide.kumpel.field_forge: Give the field forge to your Kumpel (right-click). It then smelts raw ores from its backpack into ingots, burning coal from its backpack (one piece lasts for 8 ores). As long as it has coal, it keeps raw ores until they are smelted. Pack the Kumpel up to get the forge back.

guide.kumpel.rescue_capsule: Modelled on the "Dahlbusch bomb" that brought trapped miners back to the surface in Lengede in 1963. Use it underground and hold still for three seconds, and you are pulled straight up to the surface, together with your Kumpels nearby. It only works where there is a sky above you, and it is used up.

guide.kumpel.ausfahrt: Your Kumpel remembers the way you walked underground. Sneak + right-click it with a compass and it leads you back up the same way, waiting for you if you fall behind. Glowing marks show the way.
